officialName: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
summary: Special micro-credit facility for street vendors to resume their livelihoods.

benefit.displayText: Working capital loan up to ₹10,000 initially, increasing up to ₹50,000 on repayment

eligibility.displayText: Must be a street vendor, hawker, or small trader

exclusions: Not holding a Certificate of Vending/Identity Card from Urban Local Bodies
documents: Certificate of Vending / ID card issued by ULB
applicationSteps: Visit the PM SVANidhi portal or nearest CSC
Check eligibility status using Aadhaar and mobile number
Fill out the application form online

sources.title: PM SVANidhi Official Portal
sources.publisher: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
